contradictions.null_position: Self-state must be reduced to irreducible structure.
contradictions.fudo_position: Historical residues must remain available as compost.
contradictions.resolution: Active artifacts are minimized while retired artifacts lose authority and move to compost.

contradictions.shadow_position: The project must expose irrational or taboo motives.
contradictions.transparency_position: Every shadow artifact needs source material and containment metadata.
contradictions.resolution: Dreams are generated as inspectable artifacts and cannot merge directly into main.

contradictions.existential_position: A merge must carry an irreversible decision.
contradictions.transparency_position: Friction must be auditable so it cannot become user manipulation.
contradictions.resolution: Decision rites must name costs, rejected alternatives, and failure evidence.
